bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa sde tshan dgu phyogs gcig tu bkod pa bzhugs/oṃ swasti/sangs rgyas bkra shis chos sku'i dkyil 'khor zlum/ /dam chos bkra sha

tei:div.tei:p: bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa sde tshan dgu phyogs gcig tu bkod pa bzhugs/ oṃ swasti/ sangs rgyas bkra shis chos sku'i dkyil 'khor zlum/ /

dam chos bkra shis sbyor bzhi'i 'od stong 'bar/ / dge 'dun bkra shis mkhyen gsum phyogs kun gsal/ / mchog gsum nyi ma'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog / bla ma'i bkra shis byin rlabs bdud rtsis gtams/ / yi dam bkra shis dngos grub zil dngar 'bebs/ / mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis phrin las chu gter rgyas/ / rtsa gsum zla ba'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog / chos sku'i bkra shis 'gyur med byin re chags/ / longs sku'i bkra shis lhun grub bkod re legs/ / sprul sku'i bkra shis gang 'dul rgya re che/ / sku gsum lhun po'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog / ces gnas khang g.yang chags shing*/ sbyin bdag bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel du 'jigs bral gyi slob dpon 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po dang*/ pad+ma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas lhan cig pas gsol ba btab pa sid+dhi rastu/ ༈ / tshe dpag med mgon phyag gi bum bzang bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur zhing*/ / rnam par rgyal mas sna tshogs rdo rjes mi mthun phyogs kun yongs su bcom/ / yid bzhin 'khor lo'i skyabs sbyin ut+pal byin rlabs zil dngar g.yo ba yis/ / skal ldan rnams kyi snying la sim pas 'chi med grub pa'i bkra shis shog / dge'o/ ༈ / 'byung bar dkon pa'i sangs rgyas spangs rtogs mchog / thos par dkon pa'i dam chos chags bral mchog / bsgrub par dkon ba'i dge 'dun tshogs zhing mchog / dkon pa'i mchog gyur gsum gyi bkra shis shog / dad ldan byin rlabs rtsa ba bla ma rje/ / skal ldan dngos grub rtsa ba yi dam lha/ / dam ldan phrin las rtsa ba mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ / phan bde'i rtsa lag gsum gyi bkra shis shog / chos nyid zhi ba dam pa don gyi sku/ / chos can rtag pa'i longs spyod brda yi sku/ / dbyer med gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul sprul pa'i sku/ / rab 'byams sku gsum rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog / dge'o/ ༈ / lha dbang lha yi 'byor ba chen pos mtho/

/ klu dbang klu yi nor bu chen pos brjid/ / mi dbang mi yi longs spyod chen pos khengs/ / 'jig rten chen po gsum gyi bkra shis shog / ge sar mngon shes rdzu 'phrul 'gran zla med/ / zhal lu snying stobs dpa' rgod 'gran zla med/ / khro thung 'phrul dang bkra lag 'gran zla med/ / 'gran med mi pho gsum gyi bkra shis shog / rgya bzas rgya yi rten mchog thabs kyis drangs/ / bal bzas bal po'i mchod sdong brdzongs su thob/ / 'brug mos 'brug ltar grags pa'i gtam brgyud bzhag / ya mtshan bud med gsum gyi bkra shis shog / ngo bo stong pa spros bral dbu ma che/ / rang bzhin gsal ba bde stong phyag rgya che/ / thugs rje lhun grub 'od gsal rdzogs pa che/ / gzhi rgyud chen po gsum gyi bkra shis shog / tha mal snang zhen sbyang ba bskyed pa'i rim/ / lhar snang bde chen bsgyur ba rdzogs pa'i rim/ / bde ba stong par mi phyed rdzogs rim che/ / lam rgyud rim pa gsum gyi bkra shis shog / shin tu rnam par dag pa chos kyi sku/ / ma 'gag rol par 'char ba rdzogs pa'i sku/ / gdul bya'i skal bar 'tshams pa sprul pa'i sku/ / 'bras rgyud sku gsum dbyer med bkra shis shog / sarba maṅga laṃ/ ༈ / oṃ swasti/ sangs rgyas bkra shis sgrib gnyis rdul dang bral/ / dam chos bkra shis bden gnyis 'dod rgur 'char/ / dge 'dun bkra shis tshogs gnyis gzugs mang 'dzin/ / mchog gsum nor bu'i me long bkra shis shog / sangs rgyas bkra shis spangs rtogs snying po'i bcud/ / dam chos bkra shis zhi bsil sman gyi mchog / dge 'dun bkra shis nyon mongs gdung sel phul/ / mchog gsum gi wam̐ bzang po'i bkra shis shog / sangs rgyas bkra shis rigs khams rnam par dag / dam chos bkra shis dag byed zil mngar mchog / dge 'dun bkra shis thar bde'i lang tsho rgyas/ / mchog gsum rab dkar zho yi bkra shis shog / sangs rgyas bkra shis sku gsum rtsa ba brtan/

/ dam chos bkra shis 'chi med yal 'dab rgyas/ / dge 'dun bkra shis rnam grol bcud len grub/ / mchog gsum dūr+wa'i myu gu'i bkra shis shog / sangs rgyas bkra shis sku bzhi'i 'bras bu smin/ / dam chos bkra shis lung rtogs grib ma bsil/ / dge 'dun bkra shis bslab grol don kun grub/ / mchog gsum bilba'i ljon pa'i bkra shis shog / sangs rgyas bkra shis mtshan dpe g.yas su 'khyil/ / dam chos bkra shis bden bzhi'i dbyangs snyan sgrogs/ / dge 'dun bkra shis srid pa'i rims nad gcod/ / mchog gsum chos dung dkar po'i bkra shis shog / sangs rgyas bkra shis 'gro la rjes chags mdangs/ / dam chos bkra shis shes bya rang dbang bsgyur/ / dge 'dun bkra shis bslab gzhi'i rgyal srid brtan/ / mchog gsum li khri'i thig le'i bkra shis shog / sangs rgyas bkra shis rgyun gyis rtag pa grub/ / dam chos bkra shis phan bde'i mthu chen thob/ / dge 'dun bkra shis yid srubs g.yul las rgyal/ / mchog gsum grub pa'i yungs kar bkra shis shog / ces yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis srid zhi'i dge mtshan kun gyi snying por byin gyis brlabs pa'i bkra shis rdzas mchog brgyad las nye bar drangs te brjod bya dang rjod byed gnyis ka phun sum tshogs pa'i dbyangs kyi yan lag snyan par bsgrags pa 'di'ang bstan pa rgya mtsho'i shing rta mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i khyu mchog dpal sa'i steng na 'gran zla dang bral ba'i chos kyi rje karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho phrin las kun khyab dpal bzang po'i 'dzam gling bshad sgrub bstan pa'i chu klung mtha' dag gcig tu 'khyil ba'i ma dros kyi rgya mtsho chen po dpal spungs yang khrod de wī ko ṭi dbus ma/ tsā ri tra snying po dpal chen dgyes pa'i thugs kyi pho brang sgrub pa'i sde rnams kyi spyod yul gyi grong khyer/ phya g.yang chos kyi gzhis ka bkra shis bde gnas g.yung drung 'khyil ba'i gzhal med khang chen por rten dang brten pa khor yug dang bcas pa bkra shis shing dge mtshan gyi snang ba rgyun gyis rtag cing 'dod dgur grub pa'i slad du 'jigs bral gyi slob dpon 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos skyabs gnas mchog gsum rgya mtsho mngon sum bzhin yid la bkod de mi byed dad pa'i shugs rab tu rgyas pas rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab pa ltar sde snod 'dzin pa chen po karma bkra shis zhi ba'i snying po blo gros rgyas pa'i sdes yi ger bris pa phyogs dang dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du don grub cing dge legs bkra shis kyi dga' ston yongs su rgyas par gyur cig

/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ ༈ / oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ sangs rgyas bkra shis spangs rtogs nor bus brjid/ / dam chos bkra shis lung rtogs dar shams g.yo/ / dge 'dun bkra shis rig grol yu ba brling*/ / mchog gsum gser gyi gdugs mdzes bkra shis shog / bla ma'i bkra shis byin rlabs chu gter che/ / yi dam bkra shis ye shes spyan ras gsal/ / mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis phrin las gshog rtsal bsgyur/ / rtsa gsum gser gyi nya mo'i bkra shis shog / chos sku'i bkra shis 'od gsal ltob zlum/ / longs sku'i bkra shis kha sbyor rgyan gyis spras/ / sprul sku'i bkra shis gang 'dul 'dod rgur 'char/ / sku gsum bum pa bzang po'i bkra shis shog / sku yi bkra shis mtshan dpe'i 'dab stong bzhad/ / gsung gi bkra shis zhi bsil bdud rtsis gtam/ / thugs kyi bkra shis sgrib gnyis rdul dang bral/ / gsang gsum pad+ma dkar po'i bkra shis shog / rnam mkhyen bkra shis bral smin g.yas su 'khyil/ / lam shes bkra shis lam gsum dbyangs snyan sgrog / gzhi shes bkra shis srid pa'i rims nad gcod/ / mkhyen gsum chos dung chen po'i bkra shis shog / dbu ma'i bkra shis spros bral khong seng yangs/ / phyag chen bkra shis zab gsal ri mos mdzes/ / rdzogs chen bkra shis dbyings rig 'od du 'bar/ / chen po gsum ldan dpal be'u'i bkra shis shog / gzhi rgyud bkra shis rigs khams rtsa ba brtan/ / lam rgyud bkra shis bskyed rdzogs dar 'phan 'phyo/ / 'bras rgyud bkra shis sku gnyis tog gis mdzes/ / rgyud gsum rgyal mtshan bzang po'i bkra shis shog / thog mar bkra shis byang sems gser sbyangs khams/ / bar du bkra shis dmigs med lte ba zlum/ / tha mar bkra shis yongs bsngo'i rtsibs stong bskor/ / dus gsum dge ba'i gser 'khor bkra shis shog / ces pa'ang li kyang cu'i sa 'dzin gyi thig ler/ sgrub brgyud karma kaṃ tshang gi 'khor lo gsum gyi phyag rjes lam mer gsal ba'i chos grwa chen po karma phun tshogs bstan 'phel bkra shis dar rgyas gling gaṃ bla ma dge 'dun rnams zhabs pad brtan cing*/

thugs mthun khrims gtsang*/ bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rin po che gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i ched/ smon tshig 'di lta bu bris zhes 'og min gnyis pa shar dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling gi yang khrod de wī ko ṭi'i 'jam mgon rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal slob sgrub brtson bla ma karma rig 'dzin snying pos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor sangs rgyas gnyis pa o ḍī yā na'i slob dpon mchog gis byin gyis brlabs shing*/ ris med pa'i bstan pa la dag pa'i snang ba gcig tu dkar ba shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'am/ pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa'i sdes gang shar bris pa shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig / sarba dā ka l+yā ṇaṃ bha ba tu/ ༈ / oṃ swasti/ rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor lo yi/ / thugs rjes rnam kun byin brlabs pas/ / bar du gcod pa kun zhi zhing*/ / chos mthun bsam don lhun grub shog / ces pa'ang mtsho skyes bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsol ba btab pa dge legs su gyur cig ༈ / oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bkra shis phan bde'i 'byung gnas dkon mchog gsum/ / dge legs char 'bebs rtsa gsum rab 'byams lha/ / phun tshogs 'dod rgu'i dpal ster mkha' 'gro dang*/ / chos srung nor lha rgya mtshos shis par mdzod/ / ces pa'ang mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos smras pa sid+dhi rastu/ ༈ / gangs ljongs ris med bstan pa rgya mtsho'i bdag / ngo mtshar bka' babs bdun gyi 'khor los bsgyur/ / 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos mkhyen brtse'i dbang po yi/ / ring lugs bstan pa dar rgyas bkra shis shog / ces pa'ang mañju gho ṣas bris pa'o/ / 'dis kyang ris su ma chad pa'i rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig / sarba dā maṅga laṃ bha ba tu/ dge'o// / /
